presentation_title: Code and Audio Generation: The Specialists
learning_objectives: Understand the role of generative AI in code generation.
Identify specific tools and applications of AI in programming.
Explore how generative AI is used for audio creation.
Recognize the various applications of voice synthesis and music generation.

slides.title: Welcome to Code and Audio Generation
slides.narration:
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial.
It's on Code and Audio Generation.
We will explore advanced AI applications.
Specifically, code and audio generation.
AI is making big strides here.
slides.image_prompt: Abstract digital background with glowing lines representing code and sound waves, with a friendly AI assistant character gesturing welcome.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to:
Understand AI in code generation.
Identify AI coding tools.
Explore AI in audio creation.
Recognize voice synthesis uses.
And AI music generation.
slides.image_prompt: A list of bullet points with icons representing learning, code, audio, and applications, on a clean digital background.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you need a computer.
It needs a web browser.
An active internet connection is a must.
No software installations are needed.
This is a conceptual overview.
slides.image_prompt: A laptop screen displaying a web browser, with Wi-Fi signal icon, and a mouse.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
You should know basic Generative AI.
Familiarity with text and image AI helps.
This tutorial builds on those topics.
slides.image_prompt: A stack of books or building blocks, with the top block labeled 'Code and Audio AI' and the bottom blocks labeled 'Text AI' and 'Image AI'.

slides.title: Generative AI Beyond Text and Images
slides.narration:
We've seen AI create text and images.
But AI can do more.
Its capabilities extend further.
AI now masters complex areas.
Like generating code.
And realistic audio.
Think about it.
slides.image_prompt: A futuristic cityscape with glowing lines extending from text and image icons to code symbols and musical notes, showing expansion.

slides.title: Code Generation: The Developer's Assistant
slides.narration:
Let's start with code generation.
Imagine a skilled assistant.
For developers.
AI tools learn from public code.
They enhance programming.
Significantly.
slides.image_prompt: A programmer sitting at a desk, with a holographic AI assistant floating beside them, showing lines of code on a screen.

slides.title: Introducing GitHub Copilot
slides.narration:
Meet GitHub Copilot.
It's a great example.
It's an AI model.
Trained on billions of code lines.
It integrates into your coding environment.
It's a smart programming partner.
slides.image_prompt: The GitHub Copilot logo prominently displayed, with lines of code flowing around it in a digital environment.

slides.title: How AI Assists in Coding: Code Suggestions
slides.narration:
How does Copilot help?
As you type, it suggests code.
The next few lines.
This saves time.
Developers code faster.
And more accurately.
slides.image_prompt: A code editor interface showing a developer typing, with a greyed-out suggestion box appearing automatically with code snippets.

slides.title: How AI Assists in Coding: Comments to Code
slides.narration:
AI also translates comments.
Into functional code.
Write a comment.
Describe your goal.
Copilot generates the code.
It links language and programming.
slides.image_prompt: A split screen showing a natural language comment on one side, and the corresponding generated code on the other side, with an arrow connecting them.

slides.title: How AI Assists in Coding: Bug Finding
slides.narration:
AI helps find bugs too.
It analyzes your code.
For errors.
It suggests fixes.
And improvements.
Debugging becomes efficient.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass hovering over lines of code, highlighting a red 'bug' icon, with a green 'fix' suggestion appearing.

slides.title: Benefits of AI in Software Development
slides.narration:
AI tools don't replace humans.
They empower programmers.
Developers get faster.
They become more efficient.
They focus on big problems.
And innovation.
slides.image_prompt: A developer smiling and working efficiently, surrounded by glowing graphs and symbols representing increased productivity and innovation.

slides.title: Audio Generation: The Sound Wizards
slides.narration:
Now, to audio generation.
These models are sound wizards.
They learn from sounds.
Voices and music.
They create new audio content.
Amazing, isn't it?
slides.image_prompt: An abstract representation of sound waves transforming into musical notes and speech bubbles, with a magical, wizard-like glow.

slides.title: Voice Synthesis and Text-to-Speech
slides.narration:
Voice synthesis is key.
Also called text-to-speech.
AI creates realistic voices.
Human-like voices.
Customize tones.
And emotions.
slides.image_prompt: A microphone transforming text into realistic human-like sound waves, with diverse voice icons (male, female, child) around it.

slides.title: Applications of Voice Synthesis
slides.narration:
Voice synthesis has many uses.
Audiobooks use it.
Reading becomes accessible.
AI narrates podcasts.
Virtual assistants use it.
Like Siri and Alexa.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing an audiobook, a podcast microphone, and a virtual assistant (like a smart speaker), all connected by sound waves.

slides.title: AI in Music Creation
slides.narration:
AI also makes music.
It's a revolution.
Compose royalty-free music.
For your videos.
Generate new melodies.
And harmonies.
Even create songs like famous artists.
slides.image_prompt: A musical staff with notes being generated by an AI brain icon, surrounded by various musical instruments and a video camera icon.

slides.title: Summary of Key Points
slides.narration:
To summarize.
AI goes beyond text and images.
Code tools like Copilot help developers.
They suggest code.
Translate comments.
And find bugs.
Audio AI creates voices.
And music.
These tools boost creativity.
And efficiency.
slides.image_prompt: A concise infographic summarizing code generation and audio generation, with key benefits and examples for each, on a divided screen.

slides.title: Assignment: Explore AI Tools
slides.narration:
Now, for your assignment.
Research an AI code tool.
Or an AI audio platform.
Explore its features.
See how it works.
Share your findings.
In the comments.
slides.image_prompt: A person sitting at a computer, researching, with various AI tool logos floating around them, and a thought bubble showing exploration.
